why: Disposing the HUD leaves the opener's click handler attached, so a click after teardown still pushes a layer on a disposed HUD. Under this mutation all 360 tests in hud.controls.test.ts, hud.navigation.test.ts, hud.surfaces.test.ts and hud.a11y.test.ts passed (local control run while issue #556 was open, before the new cases existed).
killedBy: createCustomizePane (issue #556) removes the opener and Back listeners it added when disposed
